elements_selected.content:
Create the themes/ directory at the repository root. Move the current built-in templates from src/web/templates/ (base.html, index.html, page.html, folder.html) into themes/default/. Add a theme.toml manifest:

```toml
[theme]
name = "default"
version = "0.9.0"
description = "The default zetl theme"
author = "zetl contributors"
license = "AGPL-3.0"

[theme.templates]
overrides = ["base.html", "index.html", "page.html", "folder.html"]
```

Keep src/web/templates/ intact for now — the include_str!() calls still reference them. The next task (compile-time embedding) will switch the source of truth. The templates in themes/default/ must be byte-for-byte identical to src/web/templates/ at this point.

REQ-014-003.
